questions.example: If the order is small, we can ship LCL instead of waiting to fill a full container.
questions.exampleZh: 如果訂單量小，我們可以走併櫃，不必等湊滿一整櫃。

options: 到岸成本（含運費、關稅等）
questions.example: Please include freight and duties so we can compare the true landed cost.
questions.exampleZh: 請把運費與關稅一併列入，好讓我們比較真實的到岸成本。

options: 商品稅則號列／關稅分類碼
questions.example: Customs asked us to confirm the correct HS code for this product.
questions.exampleZh: 海關要求我們確認這個產品正確的稅則號列。

questions.example: Please send the ASN at least 24 hours before the truck arrives.
questions.exampleZh: 請在卡車抵達前至少 24 小時寄出預先出貨通知。

questions.example: We need the signed POD before we can close this delivery ticket.
questions.exampleZh: 我們需要簽收的送達證明，才能結案這筆配送單。

questions.example: We sent an RFQ to three suppliers and will compare their quotes next week.
questions.exampleZh: 我們已向三家供應商發出詢價單，下週會比較報價。

questions.example: Our vendor scorecard tracks OTIF for every purchase order.
questions.exampleZh: 我們的供應商評分卡會追蹤每張採購單的準時且完整交貨率。

questions.prompt: 情境：報價有誤，你請廠商修正報價，最自然的說法是？
options: Please revise the quote and send us an updated version.
Please remake the quote again to me.
You must fix quote and reply fast.
questions.example: Please revise the quote and send us an updated version by Friday.
questions.exampleZh: 請修正報價，並在週五前寄給我們更新版。

questions.prompt: 情境：你要廠商先不要出貨、暫時扣住貨，最自然的說法是？
options: Please hold the shipment until we confirm the new address.
Please stop goods and wait my say.
You holding the cargo please now.
Please don't shipping until I told.
questions.example: Please hold the shipment until we confirm the new delivery address.
questions.exampleZh: 請先暫扣出貨，等我們確認新的送貨地址。

questions.prompt: 情境：你已提供方案，正在等對方確認，最自然的說法是？
options: We are awaiting your confirmation so we can proceed with the order.
We waiting you confirm then start order.
Please confirm us then we doing.
We await that you confirming soon.
questions.example: We are awaiting your confirmation so we can proceed with the order.
questions.exampleZh: 我們正等候您的確認，以便繼續處理訂單。
